evan: Quick heads-up — ran a 30m perf trace on canary for host ingress. Small requests (1-8 token pings) show an extra ~2.6ms p99 compared to baseline. Looks like parse + framing + writev syscall hotpath. Attached flame shows parse_frame and grpc_writev dominating. @mira can you weigh in on batching heuristics?

mira: Can you paste the flame / top stacks? Is this only HTTP/1 or grpc/http2 too?

evan: Mostly HTTP/1 long-poll and our streaming routes (http chunking + grpc passthrough). Quick sample from perf top:```
  23.7% parse_frame::read_until_delim
  18.2% tokenize::split_bytes
  15.9% grpc_writev
  12.4% syscall::read
  8.1% kv_cache::lookup (mostly hit)
```
Key thing: KV cache hit rate is ~92% so backend decode is fine, but host-side memcopies and per-chunk parse dominate.

jon: This matches a micro-regression I saw — when we switched to per-chunk validation we added an extra slice+copy path. Short requests kill us because batching never gets triggered.

sophie: Could we coalesce tiny requests into a short-window buffer (e.g., 30-50ms) and force autobatch N<=8? Trade latency for throughput only on <20ms tails.

evan: Proposed quick experiments:
1) writev coalescing in ingress proxy (reduce number of syscalls when chunked)
2) fast-path parser for single-chunk small payloads (avoid full protobuf decode)
3) tweak batching heuristics to group tiny tasks for 20-50ms or until batch_size=8
4) keep KV cache behavior unchanged (it's already high hit)

jon: +1 for writev coalesce. Also consider using memchr-based delim search to avoid per-byte checks. Small wins: reduce memcpy by 40-60%.

mira: If we add short-window coalesce, need safety for streaming APIs (can't break partial streams). Maybe only apply to non-streaming short routes (embeddings/ping).

evan: Agreed. I'll scope to non-streaming endpoints first. Example batching config I'm going to test:```json
{
  "tiny_request_threshold_tokens": 16,
  "coalesce_window_ms": 40,
  "min_coalesce_batch": 2,
  "max_coalesce_batch": 8
}
```

perf-bot: Benchmark run queued: canary -> writev-coalesce branch. Estimated completion in 45m.

sophie: Also log per-route chunk_count & avg_chunk_bytes for the next hour so we can prove improvement.

evan: Will do. I'll open PR with unit tests + perf harness and tag you all. If perf-bot shows p99 drop >=1.5ms we'll promote. (reacted :eyes:)

mira: Nice. If this helps the small-request tail it's a big win.

evan: Thanks — filing the ticket and PR now.
